scope: Automatic publication-job retention after terminal publication completion

behavior.trigger: Terminal kind=publication finish, or re-enqueued deletion from expired admission

coreAndNodeWorker.scope: 7 core automatic-cleanup tests, 3 existing cleanup HTTP tests, 5 Node worker tests

postgresNodeIntegration.artifactStore: real filesystem adapter in a temporary directory
postgresNodeIntegration.thumbnails: disabled for this retention integration test

rootCheck.command: pnpm check (with local PostgreSQL test database)

publicationJobsE2E.scope: Local PostgreSQL worker, CLI, browser progress viewer, real Playwright thumbnail capture and Durable Object verifier

limitations: No real cloud deployment or acceptance test.
Previously completed idle decks need a new publication or manual cleanup to start a sweep.
Thumbnail-only jobs and legacy synchronous publication do not trigger a sweep.
Retries and crash recovery wait for the next 24-hour slot.
No new Docker-image build for this automatic-retention change; previous manual-retention container evidence remains historical.

findings.finding: Late expired-admission re-enqueue could strand private input deletion
findings.resolution: Expired submit/retry re-enqueues also mark automatic cleanup pending atomically, without resetting the daily throttle

findings.finding: Refreshing the first pending alarm could postpone cleanup under repeated writes
findings.resolution: Use a stable first due timestamp rather than recomputing Date.now on every refresh

review.verification: Storage race regression tests and local workerd alarm checks passed; targeted followup found no further actionable issue.
